messages:
jenna-oncall: alert: unexpected KMS decrypt spike from a single service account, 02:13 UTC. Cloud logging shows ~120 decrypts/min vs usual <5. tagging war-room.
leo-sec: ack. which SA?
jenna-oncall: svc-data-pipeline@prod-project.seen in the payloads: downstream job retried. seeing decrypts across 3 regions.
sam-sre: can we get recent IAM changes? run `gcloud iam roles list`?
carmen-eng: checking audit log now. running filter: 
```
resource.type="k8s_container" OR resource.type="gce_instance"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="svc-data-pipeline@prod-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
timestamp>="2026-03-17T01:50:00Z"
```
jenna-oncall: miguel-bot pulled the initial alert, sending context.
miguel-bot: [automated] anomaly score 0.96 for decrypt-rate spike, created incident INC-2026-1492, paging oncall.
leo-sec: any new RBAC bindings recently? check org policy and IAM binding events.
sam-sre: IAM binding change: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` granted to svc-data-pipeline on 2026-03-16T23:05 by deploy-bot. ILO: was scheduled deploy.
carmen-eng: deploy-bot has run before, but this spike is abnormal. IPs for decrypt calls: 18.205.32.11, 34.120.10.9, 52.23.5.22 — some are unusual but map to our cloud egress ranges?
leo-sec: initial containment: rotate the service account keys and remove the direct KMS role binding from the SA, replace with short-lived access via workload identity.
jenna-oncall: agreed. action items now: 1) disable SA user-managed keys 2) remove kms role binding 3) create allowlist for expected callers 4) snapshot audit logs for forensics. I'll take 1 & 2.
sam-sre: commands to disable keys (GCP):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-data-pipeline@prod-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=...
```
leo-sec: also run this logging query to fetch decrypt contexts for last 6h (Cloud Logging):
```
logName="projects/prod-project/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "svc-data-pipeline@prod-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```
carmen-eng: pulling the payloads now. saving to secure bucket `s3://redwood-forensics/prod/INC-2026-1492/`
miguel-bot: [automated] added label `severity:high`, `impact:potential-data-access` to incident.
jenna-oncall: completed disabling 2 user-managed keys and removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` binding from SA. svc now fails decrypts. Confirmed fail rate dropped to 0 for that principal.
leo-sec: good containment. we should rotate KMS CEK (data key) because unauthorized decrypts occurred. initiate manual key rotation and schedule replay tests.
sam-sre: can we do targeted rotation only for affected KEKs? list keys: `gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=prod-keys`
carmen-eng: we need approvals for rotating master key that others depend on. opening ticket with config and impact matrix.
jenna-oncall: created JIRA REDWOODSEC-3145: "Rotate affected KMS keys + investigate svc identity compromise". Leaving notes in incident channel.
leo-sec: timeline so far: 2026-03-16T23:05 role granted by deploy-bot; 2026-03-17T02:13 decrypt spike detected; 02:20 containment (SA keys disabled, role removed); 02:45 forensics snapshot collected.
sam-sre: evidence: 120 decrypt events from that SA with request metadata showing user-agent = "data-pipeline/2.1.0" and requester IPs above. No external impersonation headers.
carmen-eng: also saw a CI job that ran at 23:00 that created a service account key artifact in artifact-store. investigating if key leaked to registry.
leo-sec: escalate to incident response lead (olivia-pager) for exec notif and compliance.
j enna-oncall: @olivia-pager we need SOC guidance for customer-data exposure assessment.
olivia-pager: on it, joining war room. what data sets are encrypted with that CEK?
leo-sec: subset: embeddings-store and logs-encrypted. need quick estimate of cardinality and owners.
jenna-oncall: owners cc'ed: @carmen-eng (ingest), @sam-sre (infra).
carmen-eng: ingest team: running query to map keys->buckets, will update within 30m.
miguel-bot: [automated] scheduled 15m recurring check until incident cleared.
leo-sec: evidence collection done, next steps: forensic timeline + KMS rotation plan + access posture changes + communication plan. assign tickets.
jenna-oncall: assigning tasks:
- jenna-oncall: containment done, monitoring for reattempts.
- leo-sec: lead for forensics and compliance writeup.
- sam-sre: lead key rotation + smoke tests.
- carmen-eng: owners mapping and data exposure estimate.
- olivia-pager: exec & legal notif, impact comms.
jenna-oncall: handing off to daytime incident commander at 08:00 UTC. summary for handoff: containment successful, decrypts stopped from compromised SA, possible CI artifact leak, KMS CEK rotation required, JIRA REDWOODSEC-3145 opened, evidence bucket `s3://redwood-forensics/prod/INC-2026-1492/`.
olivia-pager: acknowledged. will pick up at 08:00 UTC and coordinate postmortem timeline. please add any outstanding artefacts to the ticket.
leo-sec: one more: rotate any long-lived SA keys org-wide if they match patterns from artifact-store.
carmen-eng: noted. will run scan and add results to the ticket.
jenna-oncall: final note: changed alert threshold to detect similar bursts for any single principal (rate > 20/min).
miguel-bot: [automated] incident state changed to `contained`, handoff recorded.
olivia-pager: thanks team. handing off: will update execs and start SLA timeline. leaving thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
